findings.subject: Grounded Answer
findings.finding: BFR-H0 already records GROUNDED_ANSWER as ACTIVE and CKA-W9 explicitly reuses KAP grounded-answer ownership.

findings.subject: Knowledge Retrieval
findings.finding: BFR-H0 already records KNOWLEDGE_RETRIEVAL as ACTIVE and CKA-W8 binds it into the governed Ask retrieval pipeline.

findings.subject: Published Knowledge
findings.finding: BFR-H0 historical PARTIAL state reflected missing Homepage consumption, not missing CKA consumption; CKA-W8/W31 now consume published knowledge as grounding authority.

findings.subject: Related Knowledge
findings.finding: BFR-H0 historical PARTIAL state predated contextual integrations; CKA-W14 and current Book/Article/Figure entry wiring complete the CKA role without rewriting the old inventory.

findings.subject: Book / Article / Figure
findings.finding: Current page modules use the shared CKA contextual-entry helper; Figure is ACTIVE in the current implementation rather than NONE_BY_DESIGN.

findings.subject: Reality Runtime
findings.finding: Reality-aware Ask is server-authorized, explicitly disclosed and fail-closed when authorization is absent.

findings.subject: Account
findings.finding: Account continuity is hidden unless a trusted account provider returns retention-allowed data; Guest history/save is not silently persisted.

findings.subject: Journey
findings.finding: Journey escalation requires the governed complexity requirement plus explicit consent and does not replace a simple answer path.

findings.subject: Method Runtime
findings.finding: CKA exposes a handoff boundary only; Ask transport and envelopes explicitly preserve methodExecuted=false.
